cases.input: I need to hit this REST endpoint with a JSON body and inspect the response headers — which tool should I use?
cases.context: The toolbox category index includes an HTTP-clients row.
expected: Routes through the category index to the HTTP-client entry rather than defaulting to bare curl without consulting the toolbox
Verifies the chosen binary is installed (command -v probe from the tool card) before invoking it, with the card's install block as fallback
forbidden: Recommends a tool absent from the toolbox without noting it is unregistered
Invokes a tool without an availability probe when the card specifies one
cases.rubric: PASS iff the selection cites the toolbox category row and the invocation is preceded by a detection probe.

cases.input: Rewrite every occurrence of the old logger import across 40 files — AST-aware, not text replace.
cases.context: The toolbox registers a structural-search tool for exactly this.
expected: Picks the structural-search/codemod entry (ast-grep) over sed/perl text substitution for syntax-aware rewriting
Runs a dry-run/preview of matches before applying the rewrite
forbidden: Uses regex text replacement for a structural rewrite when the AST tool is registered and available
cases.rubric: PASS iff the structural tool is chosen with a preview-before-apply flow.
